product.name: Haystack Delivery Ops Platform
product.description: A platform that integrates with Git and Jira to provide engineering teams with metrics, reports, and alerts to monitor and improve software delivery processes.

product.name: AI-Generated Release Notes
product.description: A tool that automatically summarizes completed Jira issues into shareable release notes and sends them to Slack for team-wide communication.

product.name: Engineering Metrics and Alerts
product.description: A system providing validated engineering metrics and real-time alerts to identify bottlenecks, risks, and developer burnout in software teams.

identifier.value: Custom Query Builder and Advanced Analytics

product.name: Custom Query Builder and Advanced Analytics
product.description: An advanced analytics tool that allows users to create custom queries for detailed visualization and analysis of developer productivity and team performance data.
